lessons.title: RAM is your desk. Storage is your cabinet.
lessons.deck: Two kinds of space, two very different jobs.
lessons.summary: Aunt Mira keeps her desk clear and her cabinet full; both matter.
lessons.takeaway: RAM is space for now; storage is space for later.

lessons.title: Memory pressure
lessons.deck: What the Mac does when the desk is full.
lessons.summary: Swap borrows the cabinet when the desk runs out.
lessons.takeaway: Pressure, not free bytes, is the signal to watch.

lessons.title: Files and bytes
lessons.deck: Why the same file reports two sizes.
lessons.summary: The scan of secret-launch-x showed both numbers at once.
lessons.takeaway: Size on disk and size in bytes are different measurements.

lessons.title: Caches and build artifacts
lessons.summary: A cache is a bet that you will want the same thing twice.
lessons.takeaway: Rebuildable is not the same as disposable.

lessons.title: Apps and app data
lessons.deck: The app is small; its data is not.
lessons.summary: Removing an app rarely removes what the app wrote.
lessons.takeaway: Look for the data, not the icon.

lessons.title: Purgeable space
lessons.deck: Space that is free, but not yet.
lessons.summary: Snapshots hold bytes the Finder already counts as available.
lessons.takeaway: Two honest tools can report two different free-space numbers.

lessons.title: Diagnosing growth
lessons.deck: Find the cause, not the biggest folder.
lessons.summary: Growth has a direction; size alone does not.
lessons.takeaway: Compare two readings before blaming anything.
